s0101.literal: On renchen day the Central Secretariat memorialized: "The Goryeo king Wang Chŏn has repeatedly stated that the small state has narrow territory and successive years of famine and poor harvest; his new-coupon troops request to be stationed at Dongjing."
s0101.idiomatic: On renchen day the Central Secretariat reported that King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo had repeatedly pleaded narrow territory and successive famine, and asked that his new-coupon troops be stationed at Dongjing.

s0102.literal: An edict ordered them to encamp within the Beijing frontier, and also directed Dongjing Route to transport twenty thousand shi of rice to relieve Goryeo.
s0102.idiomatic: An edict ordered them to encamp within the Beijing frontier and directed Dongjing Route to transport twenty thousand shi of rice to relieve Goryeo.

s0103.literal: On dingyou day the relay stations at Zhengyang were established.
s0103.idiomatic: On dingyou day the relay stations at Zhengyang were established.

s0104.literal: An edict ordered the Henan pacification commission to transport three hundred thousand shi of rice to Heda's army in Huai-Xi, and also supply Huai-Xi and Jinghu military needs in graded amounts.
s0104.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Henan pacification commission to transport three hundred thousand shi of rice to Heda's Huai-Xi army and to supply Huai-Xi and Jinghu military needs in graded amounts.

s0105.literal: On renyin day an edict directed that the Huitong Hostel be reserved exclusively for surrendered persons coming to court.
s0105.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict directed that the Huitong Hostel be reserved exclusively for surrendered persons coming to court.

s0106.literal: Hanlin academician-expositor Helü Huosun was additionally put in charge of Huitong Hostel affairs to manage court consultations and memorial petitions of surrendered ministers.
s0106.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-expositor Helü Huosun was additionally put in charge of the Huitong Hostel to manage court consultations and petitions from surrendered ministers.

s0107.literal: Eastern campaign pacification commissioner Taqar requested a campaign against the Guwei tribe; the request was denied.
s0107.idiomatic: Eastern campaign pacification commissioner Taqar asked to campaign against the Guwei tribe; the request was denied.

s0108.literal: On bingwu day the Imperial Pharmacy was established.
s0108.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Imperial Pharmacy was established.

s0109.literal: The imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0110.literal: Ten thousand bolts of cloth were issued to Prince Tachar's division.
s0110.idiomatic: Ten thousand bolts of cloth were issued to Prince Tachar's division.

s0111.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0111.idiomatic: On yimao day in the tenth month of winter the court offered sacrifice at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0112.literal: On bingchen day the registered civilians of western Sichuan and the volunteer troops of eastern Sichuan were put to garrison farming to supply the garrison troops at Tongchuan and Qingju.
s0112.idiomatic: On bingchen day registered civilians of western Sichuan and volunteer troops of eastern Sichuan were put to garrison farming to supply the garrisons at Tongchuan and Qingju.

s0113.literal: An edict ordered Bayan and Helü Huosun to consult and implement the new regulations established by Shi Tianze and Yao Shu.
s0113.idiomatic: An edict ordered Bayan and Helü Huosun to consult and implement the new regulations Shi Tianze and Yao Shu had established.

s0114.literal: On gengshen day censorate officials reported that confiscated bribes and fines totaled one thousand three hundred ingots of paper currency.
s0114.idiomatic: On gengshen day the censorate reported that confiscated bribes and fines totaled 1,300 ingots of paper currency.

s0115.literal: An edict ordered that those in poverty who could not sustain themselves be relieved with these funds.
s0115.idiomatic: An edict ordered that those too poor to survive be relieved from these funds.

s0116.literal: Responsible offices had sentenced fifty men to death; an edict ordered further review. Thirteen who had killed in brawls were spared death and made military conscripts; the rest were ordered to be reviewed again and again before report.
s0116.idiomatic: Responsible offices had sentenced fifty men to death; an edict ordered further review. Thirteen who had killed in brawls were spared death and sent to the army; the rest were to be reviewed repeatedly before report.

s0117.literal: Setting fires on pasture lands was forbidden.
s0117.idiomatic: Setting fires on pasture lands was forbidden.

s0118.literal: Qaidar was made censor-in-chief; Xiangyang Prefecture was elevated to a route; newly conscripted troops of Guangning Prefecture were dismissed.
s0118.idiomatic: Qaidar was made censor-in-chief, Xiangyang Prefecture was elevated to a route, and newly conscripted troops of Guangning Prefecture were dismissed.

s0119.literal: The main hall, sleeping hall, incense pavilion, and wing chambers along the encircling galleries were first built.
s0119.idiomatic: The main hall, sleeping hall, incense pavilion, and wing chambers along the encircling galleries were first built.

s0120.literal: Western Sichuan grand marshal Yesudai'er and Prince Oljeitu combined forces against the Jiandu tribes, captured chiefs including Xiaji and three others, took six hundred of their people, and Jiandu then surrendered; an edict rewarded the officers and soldiers in graded amounts.
s0120.idiomatic: Western Sichuan grand marshal Yesudai'er and Prince Oljeitu combined forces against the Jiandu tribes, captured chiefs including Xiaji and three others, took six hundred of their people, and Jiandu surrendered; officers and soldiers were rewarded in graded amounts.

s0121.literal: Eleventh month, on guiwei day Buqu'er was ordered to compile the Daily Records.
s0121.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the eleventh month Buqu'er was ordered to compile the Daily Records.

s0122.literal: On dingwei day the Commission for the Promotion of Agriculture reported: "The Central Secretariat sent a document stating that as autumn grain in the capital region has just been harvested, farmers should be forbidden from double-cropping, lest it interfere with fodder and pasture."
s0122.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Commission for the Promotion of Agriculture reported that the Central Secretariat had asked, with autumn grain in the capital region just harvested, to forbid farmers from double-cropping lest it interfere with fodder and pasture.

s0123.literal: The Emperor, deeming agriculture beneficial, ordered that it not be forbidden.
s0123.idiomatic: The Emperor, deeming agriculture beneficial, ordered that it not be forbidden.

s0124.literal: Twelfth month, on the yiyou new moon, An Tong and others said: "Formerly Boqe Borotu argued that zongguan prefectures had too much power; transport commissions and military auruq offices should be established to divide their authority."
s0124.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the twelfth month An Tong and others said that Boqe Borotu had once argued zongguan prefectures held too much power and that transport commissions and military auruq offices should be established to divide it.

s0125.literal: We consider that today's civilian officials rotate by precedent without harboring subversive designs; establishing separate offices would be inconvenient for the people.
s0125.idiomatic: They argued that today's civilian officials rotated by precedent without subversive designs and that separate offices would burden the people.

s0127.literal: On renzi day one thousand ingots of paper currency were granted to wounded soldiers of Xiang and Fan.
s0127.idiomatic: On renzi day 1,000 ingots of paper currency were granted to wounded soldiers of Xiang and Fan.

s0128.literal: On jiayin day Song's Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang; the Huai-Xi branch secretariat routed him.
s0128.idiomatic: On jiayin day Song's Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang; the Huai-Xi branch secretariat routed him.

s0129.literal: On renxu day Aju was summoned together with Lu Wenhuan to audience.
s0129.idiomatic: On renxu day Aju was summoned to court together with Lu Wenhuan.

s0130.literal: The Commission for the Promotion of Agriculture requested abolishing hereditary offices in Western Xia and registering all categories of households; the request was granted.
s0130.idiomatic: The Commission for the Promotion of Agriculture asked to abolish hereditary offices in Western Xia and register all categories of households; the request was granted.

s0131.literal: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
s0131.idiomatic: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys bearing tribute.

s0132.literal: Prince Shegetu, having been assigned to military service for a crime, won repeated victories in battle and was summoned to court.
s0132.idiomatic: Prince Shegetu, assigned to military service for a crime, won repeated victories and was summoned to court.

s0133.literal: On jisi day the two counties of Guolue and Zhuyang in Shanzhou were merged into Lingbao.
s0133.idiomatic: On jisi day the counties of Guolue and Zhuyang in Shanzhou were merged into Lingbao.

s0134.literal: Wanhu Xie Ruji was granted fifteen thousand taels of silver.
s0134.idiomatic: Wanhu Xie Ruji was granted 15,000 taels of silver.

s0135.literal: Prince Borogh's son led his division with Prince Beiping Wang's combined army to suppress the rebel minister Nie Gubo and pacified him; meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in graded amounts.
s0135.idiomatic: Prince Borogh's son led his division with the Prince of Beiping to suppress the rebel Nie Gubo and pacified him; meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in graded amounts.

s0136.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
s0136.idiomatic: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.

s0137.literal: That year locust disasters on all routes reduced harvests by fifty percent; excessive rain damaged crops by ninety percent; famine relief rice totaled five hundred forty-five thousand five hundred ninety shi.
s0137.idiomatic: That year locusts on all routes cut harvests by half, excessive rain damaged crops by ninety percent, and famine relief totaled 545,590 shi of rice.

s0138.literal: Households under Heaven numbered one million nine hundred sixty-two thousand seven hundred ninety-five.

s0139.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on the jimao new moon the palace precincts were completed; the Emperor for the first time held court in the main hall and received the new year's congratulations of the crown prince, princes, and all officials.
s0139.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the jimao new moon of the first month of spring, the palace precincts were completed; the Emperor for the first time held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.

s0140.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his vice director Li Yisun and others to offer congratulations and deliver the annual tribute.
s0140.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent vice director Li Yisun and others with New Year's greetings and the annual tribute.

s0141.literal: On yiyou day Qincha, pacification commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was ordered to lead one thousand new- and veteran-coupon troops from Xiangyang to garrison Yachi.
s0141.idiomatic: On yiyou day Qincha, pacification commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was ordered to lead 1,000 new- and veteran-coupon troops from Xiangyang to garrison Yachi.

s0142.literal: On gengyin day regulations were first established for military officers to be promoted to honorary civil ranks based on merit.
s0142.idiomatic: On gengyin day regulations were first established for promoting military officers to honorary civil ranks by merit.

s0143.literal: Miscellaneous levies on military routes were remitted.
s0143.idiomatic: Miscellaneous levies on military routes were remitted.

s0144.literal: Eleven thousand five hundred troops old and new under Mangudai and others were stationed to garrison Jiandu.
s0144.idiomatic: Eleven thousand five hundred old and new troops under Mangudai and others were stationed to garrison Jiandu.

s0145.literal: The Jiandu Ningyuan Protectorate was established, concurrently administering a frontier market office.
s0145.idiomatic: The Jiandu Ningyuan Protectorate was established, concurrently administering a frontier market office.

s0146.literal: On renchen day the Western Sichuan garrison-farming pacification commission was established.
s0146.idiomatic: On renchen day the Western Sichuan garrison-farming pacification commission was established.

s0147.literal: On dingyou day a seven-day-and-night Zhou Tian golden-register ritual was performed at Changchun Palace.
s0147.idiomatic: On dingyou day a seven-day-and-night Zhou Tian golden-register ritual was performed at Changchun Palace.

s0148.literal: An edict ordered the Jinghu branch secretariat to place thirty thousand troops and five thousand water crossbow artillery crews under the Huai-Xi branch secretariat.
s0148.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Jinghu branch secretariat to place 30,000 troops and 5,000 water crossbow artillery crews under the Huai-Xi branch secretariat.

s0149.literal: On bingwu day Zhao Dangdao of Zhangde and others were executed for plotting rebellion; remaining followers were sentenced according to varying degrees of guilt.
s0149.idiomatic: On bingwu day Zhao Dangdao of Zhangde and others were executed for plotting rebellion; remaining followers were sentenced in varying degrees.

s0150.literal: Thirteen water relay stations were established at Khotan and Yarkand, and two land relay stations north of Shazhou; jade-gathering corvée for Khotan was remitted.
s0150.idiomatic: Thirteen water relay stations were established at Khotan and Yarkand and two land relay stations north of Shazhou; jade-gathering corvée in Khotan was remitted.

s0151.literal: Ala Haiya said: "Jing and Xiang have been battlegrounds since antiquity; the upper Han River is already ours — a downstream drive will surely subdue Song."
s0151.idiomatic: Ala Haiya said, "Jing and Xiang have been battlegrounds since antiquity; the upper Han is already ours, and a downstream drive will surely subdue Song."

s0152.literal: Aju also said: "In my campaigns across the Jiang and Huai I have seen Song troops weaker than before; if we do not seize them now, the moment will not come again."
s0152.idiomatic: Aju also said, "In my campaigns across the Jiang and Huai I have seen Song troops weaker than before; if we do not seize them now, the moment will not come again."

s0153.literal: The Emperor urgently summoned Shi Tianze to confer; Tianze replied: "This is a great matter of state; one senior minister such as An Tong or Bayan should be appointed to command all armies, and unified rule under Heaven can be awaited within days."
s0153.idiomatic: The Emperor urgently summoned Shi Tianze to confer. Tianze replied, "This is a great matter of state; one senior minister such as An Tong or Bayan should command all armies, and unified rule can be awaited within days."

s0154.literal: I am old, but as a deputy commander I would still suffice.
s0154.idiomatic: I am old, but as a deputy commander I would still suffice.

s0155.literal: The Emperor said: "Bayan can be entrusted with this task for me."
s0155.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Bayan can be entrusted with this task for me."

s0156.literal: Aju and Ala Haiya added: "Our southern campaign must be divided into three; existing forces are insufficient — one hundred thousand additional troops are needed."
s0156.idiomatic: Aju and Ala Haiya added, "Our southern campaign must be divided into three; existing forces are insufficient — we need 100,000 additional troops."

s0157.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to conscript one hundred thousand men.
s0157.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat to conscript 100,000 men.

s0158.literal: Second month, on the wushen new moon, Aju's officers and soldiers and Chaqan Aghilqan the elder and others were granted silver and paper currency in graded amounts.
s0158.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the second month Aju's officers and soldiers and Chaqan Aghilqan the elder and others received silver and paper currency in graded amounts.

s0159.literal: On jiayin day the moon infringed upon Jing.
s0159.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon infringed upon Jing.

s0160.literal: On gengshen day Vice Marshal Yang Yaoyuan of Xinde fell in battle; his son inherited the post.
s0160.idiomatic: On gengshen day vice marshal Yang Yaoyuan of Xinde fell in battle; his son inherited the post.

s0161.literal: The Ceremonial Guard Bureau was first established to manage palace gate keys, supply tents and lanterns.
s0161.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Guard Bureau was first established to manage palace gate keys and supply tents and lanterns.

s0162.literal: On renshen day eight hundred warships were built at Bianliang.
s0162.idiomatic: On renshen day 800 warships were built at Bianliang.

s0163.literal: Lian Xixian was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs in Beijing and other places.
s0163.idiomatic: Lian Xixian was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat and put in charge of branch secretariat affairs in Beijing and other places.

s0164.literal: The imperial carriage went to Shangdu.

s0165.literal: Third month, on jimao day an edict exhorted King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo on promoting agriculture and sericulture, and Hong Chaqiu, pacification commissioner of Goryeo military and civilians, was ordered to oversee agricultural affairs.
s0165.idiomatic: On jimao day in the third month an edict exhorted King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo on farming and sericulture, and Hong Chaqiu, pacification commissioner of Goryeo military and civilians, was ordered to oversee agricultural affairs.

s0166.literal: On jichou day Regiment Commander Chen Yan of Lu Wenhuan's staff plotted rebellion; the two ringleaders were executed, and the staff troops together with their wives and children were all ordered to move inland.
s0166.idiomatic: On jichou day regiment commander Chen Yan of Lu Wenhuan's staff plotted rebellion; the two ringleaders were executed, and the staff troops with their wives and children were all ordered to move inland.

s0167.literal: On gengyin day an edict ordered Fengzhou pacification commissioner Xindu, Goryeo pacification commissioner Hong Chaqiu, and others to lead garrison-farming troops, Jurchen troops, and naval forces totaling fifteen thousand men, with nine hundred large and small warships, to campaign against Japan.
s0167.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered Fengzhou pacification commissioner Xindu, Goryeo pacification commissioner Hong Chaqiu, and others to lead garrison-farming troops, Jurchen troops, and naval forces totaling 15,000 men, with 900 large and small warships, against Japan.

s0168.literal: Tiaomen troops were transferred to garrison Hedacheng.
s0168.idiomatic: Tiaomen troops were transferred to garrison Hedacheng.

s0169.literal: On xinmao day the two branch privy councils of Jinghu and Huai-Xi were converted into two branch secretariats; Bayan and Shi Tianze were both made left grand councillors, Aju pacification commissioner, Ala Haiya right vice director, Lu Wenhuan associate administrator; branch secretariat established at Jinghu;
s0169.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Jinghu and Huai-Xi branch privy councils were converted into branch secretariats; Bayan and Shi Tianze were both made left grand councillors, Aju pacification commissioner, Ala Haiya right vice director, and Lu Wenhuan associate administrator, with a branch secretariat at Jinghu;

s0170.literal: Heda was made left grand councillor, Liu Zheng left vice director, Tachu and Dong Wenbing associate administrators; branch secretariat established at Huai-Xi.
s0170.idiomatic: Heda was made left grand councillor, Liu Zheng left vice director, and Tachu and Dong Wenbing associate administrators, with a branch secretariat at Huai-Xi.

s0171.literal: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
s0171.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0172.literal: The Henan pacification commission reported: "Military mobilization has made transport burdensome; military and artisan households should be levied to assist finances temporarily."
s0172.idiomatic: The Henan pacification commission reported that military mobilization had made transport burdensome and that military and artisan households should be levied temporarily to assist finances.

s0174.literal: On guisi day Chang De, magistrate of Huojia County, ranked first in tax collection among all counties; an edict granted him exceptional reward.
s0174.idiomatic: On guisi day Chang De, magistrate of Huojia County, ranked first in tax collection among all counties and received exceptional reward.

s0175.literal: Yisuqidai had forcibly seized civilian rent lands, mulberry gardens, dwellings, and graves, dividing them as pasture for tummen troops; an edict ordered return to the people.
s0175.idiomatic: Yisuqidai had forcibly seized civilian rent lands, mulberry gardens, dwellings, and graves and divided them as pasture for tummen troops; an edict ordered them returned to the people.

s0176.literal: Wanhu Ali Bi had once exposed Li Tan's plot of rebellion and was killed by Tan; his son Qara Qichi inherited the post.
s0176.idiomatic: Wanhu Ali Bi had once exposed Li Tan's plot of rebellion and was killed by Tan; his son Qara Qichi inherited the post.

s0177.literal: The Jin Prefecture pacification commission was changed to a wanhu office.
s0177.idiomatic: The Jin Prefecture pacification commission was changed to a wanhu office.

s0178.literal: Yasum and Zaxin Qasi were dispatched to summon and instruct the Balur kingdom.
s0178.idiomatic: Yasum and Zaxin Qasi were dispatched to summon and instruct the Balur kingdom.

s0179.literal: Imperial preceptor 'Phags-pa returned to Tibet; his younger brother Rinchen inherited the seat.
s0179.idiomatic: Imperial preceptor 'Phags-pa returned to Tibet; his younger brother Rinchen inherited the seat.

s0180.literal: Construction of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple was completed.
s0180.idiomatic: Construction of the Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple was completed.

s0181.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day a circuit inspection and investigation commission was established for Shaanxi and Longyou circuits, with seat at Gongchang.
s0181.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the fourth month of summer a circuit inspection and investigation commission was established for Shaanxi and Longyou, seated at Gongchang.

s0182.literal: On guichou day the Eastern Palace was first built.
s0182.idiomatic: On guichou day the Eastern Palace was first built.

s0183.literal: On jiayin day rumormongers who deceived the populace in the Western Capital were executed.
s0183.idiomatic: On jiayin day rumormongers who deceived the populace in the Western Capital were executed.

s0184.literal: Horses were registered on all routes to a total of fifty thousand.
s0184.idiomatic: Horses were registered on all routes to a total of 50,000.

s0185.literal: On xinwei day an edict ordered reassurance of the cities of Wadu, Yarkand, Qashgar, and others.
s0185.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict ordered reassurance of the cities of Wadu, Yarkand, Qashgar, and others.

s0186.literal: The families of two hundred forty-nine soldiers killed in battle at Xiang and Fan were each granted one hundred taels of silver.
s0186.idiomatic: The families of 249 soldiers killed at Xiang and Fan were each granted 100 taels of silver.

s0187.literal: On yihai day Yesudai'er was ordered to lead one thousand men together with five prefectures' able-bodied men under Sargis to garrison Yidu.
s0187.idiomatic: On yihai day Yesudai'er was ordered to lead 1,000 men together with able-bodied men from five prefectures under Sargis to garrison Yidu.

s0188.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day Wang Weizheng reported that troops in his command had fled and requested selecting replacements from civilian relay households; the request was granted.
s0188.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the fifth month Wang Weizheng reported that troops in his command had fled and asked to select replacements from civilian relay households; the request was granted.

s0189.literal: An edict directed that newly conscripted troops of the Beijing, Dongjing, and other routes, fearing the summer heat unsuitable, be temporarily stationed at Shangdu.
s0189.idiomatic: An edict directed that newly conscripted troops of Beijing, Dongjing, and other routes, fearing the summer heat, be temporarily stationed at Shangdu.

s0190.literal: On yiwei day privy council officials reported: "Under the old system, of every ten Mongol soldiers receiving monthly rations only two budun did so."
s0190.idiomatic: On yiwei day privy council officials reported that under the old system only two budun of every ten Mongol soldiers receiving monthly rations were entitled to them.

s0191.literal: Now when Kheshig Dan Qaidan was sent to verify the numbers, two thousand six hundred seventy extra men were found on the rolls.
s0191.idiomatic: When Kheshig Dan Qaidan was sent to verify the numbers, 2,670 extra men were found on the rolls.

s0192.literal: An edict ordered Qaidan caned, barred from imperial guard service, and banished to the western Sichuan front to serve until death in the army; the rest were sentenced according to varying degrees.
s0192.idiomatic: An edict ordered Qaidan caned, barred from imperial guard service, and banished to the western Sichuan front to serve until death; the rest were sentenced in varying degrees.

s0193.literal: On bingshen day the imperial princess Qutluq Jalaimishi was given in marriage to Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm.
s0193.idiomatic: On bingshen day the imperial princess Qutluq Jalaimishi was given in marriage to Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm.

s0194.literal: On xinchou day an edict ordered that for newly conscripted troops on each route, household silk and silver levies distributed among the people were all remitted.
s0194.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered that household silk and silver levies distributed among the people for newly conscripted troops on each route be remitted.

s0195.literal: Sixth month, on the bingwu new moon Liu Zheng requested additional armor and weapons and water crossbow crews; these were granted.
s0195.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month Liu Zheng requested additional armor, weapons, and water crossbow crews; these were granted.

s0196.literal: On gengxu day Jiandu warrior Qama'ili and others were granted silver and paper currency in graded amounts.
s0196.idiomatic: On gengxu day Jiandu warrior Qama'ili and others received silver and paper currency in graded amounts.

s0197.literal: On guichou day an edict ordered Heda to select five thousand Mongol troops from his command to garrison riverine fortresses together with Han troops as guards for courier travel.
s0197.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered Heda to select 5,000 Mongol troops from his command to garrison riverine fortresses with Han troops as guards for courier travel.

s0198.literal: Gubilai Bator and Zhai Wenbin were further ordered to lead ten thousand troops to raid Yashan in southern Jing to pin down Song's western forces.
s0198.idiomatic: Gubilai Bator and Zhai Wenbin were further ordered to lead 10,000 troops to raid Yashan in southern Jing and pin down Song's western forces.

s0199.literal: On bingchen day conscription was remitted in Shangdu and Longxing routes.
s0199.idiomatic: On bingchen day conscription was remitted in Shangdu and Longxing routes.

s0200.literal: On gengshen day war was declared against Song; an edict addressed the branch secretariat and Mongol and Han army wanhu and qianhu soldiers, saying:
s0200.idiomatic: On gengshen day war was declared against Song; an edict addressed the branch secretariat and Mongol and Han wanhu and qianhu soldiers, saying:
